cohort: The study participants were 284 neonates admitted to the NICU at PRM Medical College, Baripada, over a two-year period between January 2022 and December 2023.
finding: The study found that preterm birth and neonatal sepsis were independent predictors of mortality among neonates admitted to the NICU.
birth_weight: Babies included had a range of birth weights, with 58.5% having low birth weight (<2500g).
gest_age: Babies included had a range of gestational ages, with 42.3% being preterm.
